title: 1828 Prairie's porch reaches back to its bay on a third column
items: 1828 Prairie's porch no longer stops short of the canted bay beside it: its south end now runs back on a diagonal to the bay's cheek, on a third round column, with its arch turned between the columns, as the automobile photograph shows it.
A terrace now runs south of the stoop under that arch, its stone front pierced by four slots.
